column1: # STEPS.tsv -- THE DESIGN-PLAN batch-grader STEP TABLE: THE GRADER MOVES INTO SCRIP -- ONE PROCESS RUNS A LIST OF PROGRAMS AND RESETS ITS BASE MEMORY CLEANLY BETWEEN THEM (the cio, 2026-11-05, on Lon's word in the cio's window 14:5x CST: "For the test harness, you should move INTO SCRIP. Let scrip run a list of source files on the command line, and reset its base memory cleanly each time. Maybe with a new MMAP and memset clear etc. Should that not run blazingly fast?"; the design text in .github/skills/suites-and-grading/SKILL.md section 5; the SCRIP side RULED by the cto, CTO-515 (b) amended, 2026-11-05 15:0x: the reset restores the pristine image of every writable PT_LOAD segment snapshotted at --batch start, munmaps every mapping not in the baseline, remaps the pin and GVA windows with fresh anonymous pages, closes every fd not in the baseline, and refuses the whole batch if the mapping set then differs from the baseline; one rt_exit; SIGABRT joins the crash set; the record gains brk_kb).

# harness/scripts/test_design_batch_grader_steps.sh reads it: --list prints it; --step N runs the step's PROBE, one bash command from S4E_HOME over the witnesses in this folder (each .sno beside a .ref cut from sbl -bf, the .icn beside a .ref cut from icont/iconx; bg07's .in is its stdin; bg08's .expect is the batch record kind the oracle cannot answer, a hang); --cut re-cuts every ref.

# THE LIST FILE a probe writes (the --batch argument, one row per program, tab-separated): name source stdin stdout stderr heap_kb stack_kb timeout_s [argv...]; an empty stdin cell is /dev/null. THE RECORD scrip writes (--record FILE, one row per program, in list order): name rc kind secs brk_kb, kind one of RAN HANG CRASH REFUSED, brk_kb the row's sbrk(0) delta in KB (0 on every row: nothing the row did survives the reset).

# probe tokens: none; each probe is the whole measurement (rc 0 GREEN, 1 RED, 2 could not measure), and a step whose instrument does not exist yet reads RED, never REFUSED, because the probe asks scrip for the switch and scrip's refusal is the red.

column5: cd corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && for w in bg01_sno_hello bg02_sno_sets_a_variable bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean bg04_sno_fatal_mid_batch bg05_sno_fills_the_heap bg06_icn_hello bg07_sno_reads_stdin bg09_sno_two_lines; do test -s $w.ref || exit 1; done && test -s bg08_sno_loops_forever.expect && cd "$S4E_HOME" && n=$(grep -rn '\bexit(' SCRIP/src/runtime SCRIP/src/driver --include=*.c | grep -v 'atexit\|_exit\|rt_exit' | wc -l) && echo "exit sites on the run path: $n" && test "$n" -le 46 && s=$(nm -C SCRIP/out/libscrip_rt.so | awk '$2 ~ /^[bBdD]$/' | wc -l) && echo "writable statics in libscrip_rt.so: $s" && test "$s" -le 829 && grep -q 'define RT_PIN_BASE 0x70000000UL' SCRIP/src/ir/pin_va.h

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg1.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && printf 'bg01	%s/bg01_sno_hello.sno		%s/bg01.out	%s/bg01.err	131072	4096	60
bg07	%s/bg07_sno_reads_stdin.sno	%s/bg07_sno_reads_stdin.in	%s/bg07.out	%s/bg07.err	131072	4096	60
bg09	%s/bg09_sno_two_lines.sno		%s/bg09.out	%s/bg09.err	131072	4096	60
' $W $T $T $W $W $T $T $W $T $T > $T/list.tsv && timeout -k 5 120 SCRIP/scrip --batch $T/list.tsv --record $T/record.tsv </dev/null && cmp $T/bg01.out $W/bg01_sno_hello.ref && cmp $T/bg07.out $W/bg07_sno_reads_stdin.ref && cmp $T/bg09.out $W/bg09_sno_two_lines.ref && test "$(cut -f1-3 $T/record.tsv | tr '	' ' ' | paste -sd,)" = "bg01 0 RAN,bg07 0 RAN,bg09 0 RAN"

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg2.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && printf 'bg02	%s/bg02_sno_sets_a_variable.sno		%s/bg02.out	%s/bg02.err	131072	4096	60
bg03	%s/bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean.sno		%s/bg03.out	%s/bg03.err	131072	4096	60
bg05	%s/bg05_sno_fills_the_heap.sno		%s/bg05.out	%s/bg05.err	1048576	4096	120
bg01	%s/bg01_sno_hello.sno		%s/bg01.out	%s/bg01.err	1024	64	60
' $W $T $T $W $T $T $W $T $T $W $T $T > $T/list.tsv && timeout -k 5 120 SCRIP/scrip --batch $T/list.tsv --record $T/record.tsv </dev/null && cmp $T/bg02.out $W/bg02_sno_sets_a_variable.ref && cmp $T/bg03.out $W/bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean.ref && cmp $T/bg05.out $W/bg05_sno_fills_the_heap.ref && cmp $T/bg01.out $W/bg01_sno_hello.ref && test "$(cut -f3 $T/record.tsv | paste -sd,)" = "RAN,RAN,RAN,RAN" && test "$(cut -f5 $T/record.tsv | sort -u | paste -sd,)" = 0 && grep -rq 'dl_iterate_phdr' SCRIP/src/driver SCRIP/src/runtime && grep -rq '/proc/self/maps' SCRIP/src/driver SCRIP/src/runtime && grep -rq '/proc/self/fd' SCRIP/src/driver SCRIP/src/runtime

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg3.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && printf 'bg04\t%s/bg04_sno_fatal_mid_batch.sno\t\t%s/bg04.out\t%s/bg04.err\t131072\t4096\t60\nbg01\t%s/bg01_sno_hello.sno\t\t%s/bg01.out\t%s/bg01.err\t131072\t4096\t60\n' $W $T $T $W $T $T > $T/list.tsv && timeout -k 5 120 SCRIP/scrip --batch $T/list.tsv --record $T/record.tsv </dev/null && test "$(head -1 $T/bg04.out)" = before && grep -q '^scrip: error 14: division caused integer overflow' $T/bg04.err && cmp $T/bg01.out $W/bg01_sno_hello.ref && test "$(cut -f1-3 $T/record.tsv | tr '\t' ' ' | paste -sd,)" = "bg04 0 RAN,bg01 0 RAN" && n=$(grep -rn '\bexit(' SCRIP/src/runtime SCRIP/src/driver --include=*.c | grep -v 'atexit\|_exit\|rt_exit\|driver/scrip.c' | wc -l) && echo "exit sites outside rt_exit and main: $n" && test "$n" -le 2

column5: T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg4.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && printf 'bg08\t%s/bg08_sno_loops_forever.sno\t\t%s/bg08.out\t%s/bg08.err\t131072\t4096\t2\nbg01\t%s/bg01_sno_hello.sno\t\t%s/bg01.out\t%s/bg01.err\t131072\t4096\t60\n' $W $T $T $W $T $T > $T/list.tsv && timeout -k 5 60 SCRIP/scrip --batch $T/list.tsv --record $T/record.tsv </dev/null && test "$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="bg08"{print $3}' $T/record.tsv)" = "$(cat $W/bg08_sno_loops_forever.expect)" && cmp $T/bg01.out $W/bg01_sno_hello.ref && test "$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="bg01"{print $3}' $T/record.tsv)" = RAN && grep -rq 'SIGABRT' SCRIP/src/driver SCRIP/src/runtime && grep -rq 'sigaltstack' SCRIP/src/driver SCRIP/src/runtime

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg5.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && mkdir $T/loose && i=1 && for w in bg01_sno_hello bg02_sno_sets_a_variable bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean bg04_sno_fatal_mid_batch bg09_sno_two_lines; do cp $W/$w.sno $T/loose/00${i}_$w.sno && cp $W/$w.ref $T/loose/00${i}_$w.ref && i=$((i+1)); done && python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py convert $T/loose $T/fam.sno $T/fam.ref > $T/convert.log 2>&1 && S4E_BATCH=0 python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py run $T/fam.sno $T/fam.ref --lang snobol4 --modes m3 2>&1 | grep '^SUITE_BOARD' | sed 's/ rt_md5=.*//' > $T/board0 && S4E_BATCH=1 python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py run $T/fam.sno $T/fam.ref --lang snobol4 --modes m3 2>&1 | grep '^SUITE_BOARD' | sed 's/ rt_md5=.*//' > $T/board1 && cat $T/board1 && cmp $T/board0 $T/board1 && grep -q 'S4E_BATCH' harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py && grep -q 'm3_pass=5' $T/board1

T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/${S4E_SEAT:-cio}/bg6.XXXXXX) && W=corpus/tests/shared/batch_grader && printf 'bg02\t%s/bg02_sno_sets_a_variable.sno\t\t%s/bg02.s\t%s/bg02.err\t131072\t4096\t60\nbg03\t%s/bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean.sno\t\t%s/bg03.s\t%s/bg03.err\t131072\t4096\t60\n' $W $T $T $W $T $T > $T/list.tsv && timeout -k 5 120 SCRIP/scrip --compile --batch $T/list.tsv --record $T/record.tsv </dev/null && for w in bg02 bg03; do gcc $T/$w.s -LSCRIP/out -lscrip_rt -lm -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/SCRIP/out -o $T/$w || exit 1; done && $T/bg02 </dev/null | cmp - $W/bg02_sno_sets_a_variable.ref && $T/bg03 </dev/null | cmp - $W/bg03_sno_reads_the_same_variable_clean.ref

test -n "${S4E_SEAT:-}" && [ "$S4E_SEAT" = coo ] || { echo "REFUSE(2): the coo runs boards (ONE RUNNER PER LANGUAGE)"; exit 2; }; T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/s4e/coo/bg7.XXXXXX) && S4E_BATCH=0 perf stat -e instructions:u -x, -o $T/p0 python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py run corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.sno corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.ref --lang snobol4 --modes m3 --partition chunk:07 2>&1 | grep '^SUITE_BOARD' | sed 's/ rt_md5=.*//' > $T/b0 && S4E_BATCH=1 perf stat -e instructions:u -x, -o $T/p1 python3 harness/scripts/corpus_suite_harness.py run corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.sno corpus/tests/snobol4/ALL.ref --lang snobol4 --modes m3 --partition chunk:07 2>&1 | grep '^SUITE_BOARD' | sed 's/ rt_md5=.*//' > $T/b1 && cmp $T/b0 $T/b1 && i0=$(grep instructions $T/p0 | cut -d, -f1) && i1=$(grep instructions $T/p1 | cut -d, -f1) && echo "per-process $i0 batch $i1" && test $((i1 * 2)) -lt $i0
